Standzeit

The total duration an aircraft spends on the ground between landing and takeoff, including taxiing, servicing, and boarding operations.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Standzeit?

In this glossary, Standzeit refers to: The total duration an aircraft spends on the ground between landing and takeoff, including taxiing, servicing, and boarding operations.

How is Standzeit used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Die Fluggesellschaft optimiert die Umlaufprozesse, um die Standzeit an großen Drehkreuzen zu verkürzen."

Why does Standzeit matter in aviation?

Standzeit matters because it supports clear communication in Ground Ops contexts for Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as ICAO Level 4, ICAO Level 5, ICAO Level 6, and EASA FCL.055.

Who uses Standzeit?

Standzeit is mainly used by Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew.

What category does Standzeit belong to?

Where does this definition come from?
